lines.say: Myth. Rereading your notes the night before your mocks is revision.
Fact. Rereading feels good because it's familiar. Familiar isn't the same as remembered.
Myth. If you can blurt it, you know it.
Fact. Blurting is only half of it. The other half is checking what you missed.
Offload does blurting from your own notes, then shows you the gaps.
So. Myth or fact: rereading is revision?
